name: Orb web
title: The task sits at the hub.
caption: Threads carry the work. Pull one and you can see what moves.
notes: Task & progress: the hub ring fills as agents finish. 4 of 12 done.
Agents & subagents: main agents sit on spokes; subagents hang further out on their parent's thread.
Delegation, waiting, messages, tools: spokes delegate, dashed arcs mean waits-for, dotted green threads are messages, chips name the live tool.
Blocked, failed, outputs: amber tag says what is needed, rust tag shows the failure and the retry, page glyphs are outputs.

name: Hive cells
title: Every agent holds a cell.
caption: A territory view: who owns which cell, and what state it is in.
notes: Task & progress: the queen cell is the orchestrator; its ring is task progress.
Agents & subagents: full cells are main agents; small satellite cells are their subagents.
Delegation, waiting, messages, tools: adjacency and solid links delegate, dashed lines wait, dotted green lines message.
Blocked, failed, outputs: cell fill carries the state; callouts say why; page glyphs sit on the cell that made them.

name: Radar
title: Distance from the task.
caption: Rings are delegation depth. Angle groups related work. Green trails show who moved recently.
notes: Task & progress: the outer ring fills clockwise with finished agents.
Agents & subagents: depth 1 agents ring the center; subagents sit on depth 2 behind their parent.
Delegation, waiting, messages, tools: radial lines delegate, dashed chords wait, dotted green chords are messages.
Blocked, failed, outputs: blips change glyph and callout; page glyphs mark outputs.

name: Routed lattice
title: Handoffs run on the grid.
caption: Right angles only, like a circuit board. Everything that moves has a wire.
notes: Task & progress: the task starts at the left edge; the right edge is the final release.
Agents & subagents: chips on the grid; subagents branch off their parent's wire.
Delegation, waiting, messages, tools: grey rails delegate, dashed wires wait, green wires with a packet are messages.
Blocked, failed, outputs: a blocked or failed chip has a labelled callout; page glyphs sit on the chip's output side.

name: Contribution river
title: How everything feeds the result.
caption: Width is effort. Follow the river from the plan to the final release.
notes: Task & progress: the river runs left to right; the empty channel on the right is the unfinished result.
Agents & subagents: bars are agents; subagents join the river as side streams.
Delegation, waiting, messages, tools: ribbons are contributions; dashed ribbons are work not yet flowing.
Blocked, failed, outputs: an amber bar is a dam, a rust bar is an eddy; page glyphs are outputs dropped along the way.

name: Floorplan
title: An office, with the plumbing showing.
caption: Rooms are workstreams. Desks hold agents. Documents pile up on the desks that made them.
notes: Task & progress: the clock in Command shows task progress.
Agents & subagents: desks in a room; subagents share their parent's room.
Delegation, waiting, messages, tools: dashed lines show who waits for whom, dotted green lines are messages, chips name the live tool.
Blocked, failed, outputs: callouts say what is needed or what failed; the dashed outbox is the unfinished result.

name: Swimlanes
title: Time, one lane per agent.
caption: A timeline of the whole run. The dashed line is now; everything to its right is still planned.
notes: Task & progress: the NOW line against the full run length, plus the percent done.
Agents & subagents: one lane each, subagents sit directly under their parent.
Delegation, waiting, messages, tools: curves are handoffs, dotted green curves are messages, dotted lane segments are waiting.
Blocked, failed, outputs: amber hatched bars are blocked, rust bars failed, page glyphs mark each output when it appeared.

name: Territories
title: Every agent owns a patch.
caption: A map. States color the land. Lines show how the territories depend on each other.
notes: Task & progress: the share of the map already claimed.
Agents & subagents: a main agent owns a region; its subagents live inside it.
Delegation, waiting, messages, tools: dashed lines are waits-for, dotted green lines are messages, chips name the live tool.
Blocked, failed, outputs: region tint and callouts; page glyphs sit on the seed that produced them.

name: Card tree
title: Delegation, as an org chart.
caption: Cards say what each agent is doing in words, so you can read the run like a status report.
notes: Task & progress: the orchestrator card at the left root, with percent done.
Agents & subagents: columns are depth; subagent cards sit to the right of their parent.
Delegation, waiting, messages, tools: elbows delegate, dashed arcs on the right are waits-for, dotted green arcs are messages.
Blocked, failed, outputs: each card states why in words; page glyphs sit on the card's corner.

name: Message matrix
title: Who is talking to whom.
caption: A table of every relationship: rows send, columns receive. The diagonal shows each agent's own state.
notes: Task & progress: the line above the matrix summarizes progress and message count.
Agents & subagents: rows and columns are the same twelve agents.
Delegation, waiting, messages, tools: solid outline is delegation, dashed outline is waits-for, a green cell is a message.
Blocked, failed, outputs: the diagonal carries each agent's state glyph; page glyphs in the right column are outputs.
